title: Bind port9 low-cache digits to the complete-owner carry leaf
body:
PR5849's complete-owner carry leaf receives an already formed descriptor; its actual low-cache producer remained unconnected. This package binds the released port9 inverse column1 at q5 to the unchanged PR5332 frontend and unchanged generic PR5849 rotation through literal tape/symbol translation, followed by owned-descriptor erasure.

The fixed program physically scans a supplied64-digit cache, derives the seven possible carry codes, preserves the cache, returns all work/heads and retains the declared three-bit new-low output. No runtime host-selected offset is used. A written composition argument includes the complete leaf allowances `393V+600L+30000` transitions and `43V+8L+500` visited cells, with `V=PQS`, `L=bit_length(Q)`, odd `Q>=3`.

Evidence: native Windows CPython3.12.11 registered normal/optimized runs recompute the same receipt;125 influential low triples,20 complete compositions in each of two literal interpreters, every source/consumer instruction, all cells/heads/per-tape visited intervals, and8 exact-reason rejecting controls. Metadata and18-file committed-byte/source-history preflight pass. Each sign has51,350 fixed instructions. Root source/proof review strengthened rejection reasons and per-tape interval comparison before registered acceptance.

This is one supplied-cache/supplied-owner leaf interface. The actual64-coordinate owner at cell1 has `P=Q,S=Q^62*Z`; Q125 with P=S1 is a small leaf fixture, not its materialization. Cache formation, whole-T selection/staging, homogeneous routing, low-type commit/retirement, ROW installation, a favorable complete supplier invoice, hosted CI and human/kernel acceptance remain open. The negative sign reverses this carry only, not the full opposite matrix route. No new kappa or selected-frontier change.

Only `research/port9-low-cache-carry/` is added from refreshed main `a5bff3bf133e482541c09eba4e773884bdb2b1b7`, revision8, selected #6030. Live overlap through03:55UTC covered357 open PRs,5977 Discussion records and all HEAD notes; the extra matches were this claim/package. Canonical coordination: https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/4945#discussioncomment-19284595. The broader released R17 join remains open.

Credit JoyboyBrian/PR5332 (`8e96c889b924957c599687be56b19fce9161cad3`), Ali Romman/PR5849 (`35ee8364ccfe54d6d5ec154fbf74993624b0a0d4`), David Arias/PR2776, Charles Bethin, Jose Manuel, Nick Petalas, Tekalign, ToikY and the retained G20/native/ROW lineage. Frozen sources are unchanged. AAAmirinu with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance, including parallel proof/implementation/checking and root review. Apache-2.0.

Reproduce: `python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/port9-low-cache-carry`; `python -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/port9-low-cache-carry --check-source-history`.
